query_normalized: evaluating the statistical validity of crowdsourced labels statistics
rationale: This paper satisfies criterion (a) and (b) because it directly measures the statistical quality and reliability of crowdsourced labels (weather observations) and proposes a specific statistical metric (Veracity Score) to evaluate their validity, which is the core mechanism the user is asking about.
